The claim 6476714931 served `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by path mandate; this review is served at that tier.

### ① Derived judgments

- Status line: 「Accepted (2026-10-28, #27251) · **Amended** (2026-10-28, #27291 — one clause each; …)」 — a reading of fact (PR #27251 merged 2026-10-28 by `os-zhuang`; the record itself said it becomes Accepted by that merge) in ADR-0087's house spelling; `scripts/adr-index.mjs` keys the earliest status keyword, so the index reads Accepted. Holds.
- D1 citation (L63–66): 「ADR-0087's #18003 level-half amendment of 2026-09-13 — the note inside its "Ratified: the pre-launch launch-window exemption" section — and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`」 — that note is ADR-0087 L498 on main; the other 2026-09-13 text is the #12772 addendum (L1240 heading); the amendment note quotes the former wording verbatim. Should-fix 6 met. Holds.
- D2 ui-only clause (L87–90): R is read off the first `@objectstack/spec` release tag whose tree carries the tombstone's introducing commit, on the `.0.0`-cut convention, ⛔ never off `@object-ui/types`' own tags — the dev's three test cases (born between `@object-ui/types@16.1.0` and `17.1.0` before the `spec@17.0.0` cut ⇒ R = 16; first carried by 17.x after that cut ⇒ 17; after 18.0.0 ⇒ 18) agree with the spec's clock; the note quotes the former wording verbatim and names the 17.1.0 fact (registry re-read by the dev and by the seat: no `@object-ui/types@17.0.0`). Should-fix 5 met in substance. Holds — with the one must-fix below on the text the clause cites.
- The decision (one major after the retirement, never longer), D3, D4, D5 untouched. Holds.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` correct; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, matching the claim.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Must-fix 1 — 〈Applying the rule〉 step 2 (L144–149) now contradicts the amended D2.** Step 2 still tells the batch to date a pre-merge ui tombstone on a full clone of `objectstack-ai/objectui` 「whose `@object-ui/types@*` tags carry that era」 and to take 「the first release tag that contains it (`git tag --contains`)」 — on that clone the tag found is an `@object-ui/types` tag, exactly the reading the new D2 clause forbids (⛔ Never off `@object-ui/types`' own tags). The new clause's parenthesis points at step 2 for 「the first cut after its date」, but step 2 does not say that. One clause in step 2 is owed: the objectui clone gives the introducing commit and its date; R is then read on the group's clock per D2 (the first `@objectstack/spec@M.0.0` cut at or after that commit, counted in the major before it), ⛔ not from the ui tag the clone's `git tag --contains` names. Same file, inside this card's should-fix 5.
- **Must-fix 2 — `docs/adr/README.md` is generated and now stale for this ADR's own row** (its status cell reads 「Proposed — 2026-10-28. `docs/adr/` is Tier H …」 on the head). Regenerate with the repo's tooling (`pnpm adr:index`) and commit the result; the regen also refreshes the ADR-0035 row that #27069 left stale — a generated-file catch-up, named in the PR body, not a widening. (CI's `check:adr-index` is `--report`, so the PR is green either way; the index is what a reader opens first, and a status this PR changes must show there.)
- Accepted: the commit trailer is the repo's model-free pair; the formula/lint prerequisite build for the derived doc-formula gate; `check:role-word` not derived (its roots exclude `docs/adr/`) — the order's hypothesis 4 falsified on that one name; two lines at 121–122 chars (no gate reads line length under `docs/adr/`; the file already carried longer lines).
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; `api_writes` 2 (both relay); the relay requested `hotlong` and `os-zhuang` on `pr_create` (the relay's act); draft, no flip by anyone.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the ruling (letter A on #25912, executed as written and not re-opened): both clauses narrow a reading error without touching the decision; the ui-only clock is now the group's clock, which is what D1's 「one clock serves both faces」 already said — the amendment removes the one place the record contradicted itself. Against the four-axis frame: AI-error (the ⛔ on reading `@object-ui/types`' own tags is explicit, not left to inference), long-run (one clock, one citation, history kept in the notes), focus (two clauses, one file). Holds once step 2 says the same thing — a batch runner reads step 2, not D2, when it dates a pre-merge tombstone.

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27333 · head `0a594eb2` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T19:15Z

- 改了什么:ADR-0145 两处修订(分诊对 PR #27251 复审留下的两条非阻塞 should-fix):① D2 的「仅 ui 退役」时钟改读固定发布组的 `@objectstack/spec` 标签 —— 以首个包含引入提交的 spec 发布标签定 R,`.0.0` 切点计入前一个 major,⛔ 不再读 `@object-ui/types` 自己的标签(它的 17 从 `17.1.0` 起,没有 `17.0.0`,旧读法让一个在 `spec@17.0.0` 切点前出生的墓碑多活一个 major);〈Applying the rule〉第 2 步同句对齐(objectui 全量克隆只给出引入提交与日期,R 仍按组时钟读);② D1 对 ADR-0087 的引用点名 #18003「level half」修订(2026-09-13 有两段文本,D1 指第二段)。状态行按 ADR-0087 的拼法写成 `Accepted (2026-10-28, #27251) · Amended (2026-10-28, #27291 …)`,每处改动下留 `> Amended` 注引旧文;`docs/adr/README.md` 由 `adr-index.mjs` 重生成(顺带补上 #27069 留下的 ADR-0035 行)。
- 为什么改:你的裁决 A(#25912,6407810703)要求 ui 墓碑「晚于其所名退役一个 major,⛔ 不更长」;旧 D2 的 ui-only 读法在 ui 包跳过 `.0.0` 标签时恰好多出一个 major,与 D1 自相矛盾;引用歧义会让读者翻到另一段同日期文本。
- 风险与回滚:只改 ADR 文本与生成索引,不删墓碑、不改代码或 schema;裁决本身(一个 major、不更长)、D3、D4、D5 未动。回滚 = revert 两个 commit。
- 先看:L87–96(D2 ui-only 新句 + 注)、L151–158(第 2 步新句)、L63–66(D1 引用 + 注)、L3–6(状态行)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` → OK;`grep -n "object-ui/types" docs/adr/0145-*.md` → 只剩「⛔ never」与注里的旧文。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(`docs/adr/**`)—— 请审批人(`hotlong` / `os-zhuang`,中继已请审)批准或亲手 ready + 入队;本 PR 保持 draft,批准在案后席位落地。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。首轮复核 FAIL(6477458239:第 2 步与新 D2 相悖;索引未重生成),一轮返工 `0a594eb2` 两条全补,delta 复核 PASS(6477821836);PR 正文里「第 2 步已一致」一句与「README 未重生成」一条由本记录撤回(dev 按角色文件不 PATCH 正文,改法在其报告 6477732928)。
